request_payload.title: Antibody formation and efficacy of enzyme replacement therapy in adults with Pompe disease: Unlocking long-term insights.

mentions.sentence: PURPOSE: Anti-recombinant human acid α-glucosidase (rhGAA) antibodies can develop in adult Pompe patients receiving enzyme replacement therapy (ERT), but their long-term impact on clinical treatment outcomes is currently unclear.

candidates.label: Laronidase (enzyme replacement for MPS I)
candidates.summary: Intravenous recombinant alpha-L-iduronidase for MPS I. It does not cross the blood-brain barrier, so it is not expected to treat the brain disease of the severe

candidates.label: Idursulfase (enzyme replacement for MPS II)
candidates.summary: Intravenous recombinant iduronate-2-sulfatase for Hunter syndrome (MPS II).

candidates.label: Olipudase alfa (enzyme replacement for ASMD)
candidates.summary: Intravenous recombinant acid sphingomyelinase, approved only for the non-brain manifestations of ASMD.

candidates.label: Cerliponase alfa (intraventricular enzyme replacement for CLN2)
candidates.summary: Recombinant TPP1 delivered straight into the fluid spaces of the brain, bypassing the blood-brain barrier. It slows the loss of walking and language in CLN2 dis

candidates.label: Enzyme replacement for Gaucher disease (imiglucerase, velaglucerase alfa, taliglucerase alfa)
candidates.summary: Intravenous replacement of the missing glucocerebrosidase enzyme. Approved for the body (non-brain) manifestations of Gaucher disease; it does not treat the bra

candidates.label: Pabinafusp alfa (brain-penetrant enzyme replacement for MPS II)
candidates.summary: Iduronate-2-sulfatase fused to an antibody that ferries it across the blood-brain barrier via the transferrin receptor, aimed at the neurological form of MPS II

candidates.label: Enzyme replacement for Fabry disease (agalsidase beta, pegunigalsidase alfa)
candidates.summary: Intravenous replacement of alpha-galactosidase A for people with Fabry disease.

candidates.label: Enzyme replacement for Pompe disease (alglucosidase alfa, avalglucosidase alfa, cipaglucosidase alfa)
candidates.summary: Intravenous replacement of acid alpha-glucosidase, the only disease-specific treatment class for Pompe disease.

candidates.label: scAAV9.P546.SLC6A1 intrathecal gene replacement
candidates.summary: A virus-delivered extra copy of SLC6A1, given into the spinal fluid, to restore GABA re-uptake. First-in-human trial is open by invitation.

candidates.label: Intrathecal AAVrh8-HEXA/HEXB gene therapy (Tay-Sachs)
